QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`, and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are also off (lines 2185, 2196).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the shipped config leaves THREADING_C off, along with the PTHREAD and ALT variants, so a default build defines none of them. That covers the item's two threading macros.
